system.name: LayerNorm tuning
system.one_liner: Finetune an LLM into a multimodal LLM by training only the LayerNorm weights in each attention block, using fewer parameters and less memory than LoRA.

content.variant_note: three identical MLLM stacks that differ only in which modules are trainable, (a) being the proposed LayerNorm tuning, with two horizontal bar charts of cost at the right
content.argues: Tuning only the LayerNorms inside attention blocks needs far fewer trainable parameters and less GPU memory than QV-projection/MLP tuning or LoRA at both 7B and 13B.
content.subject: Three MLLM stacks with trainable parts in blue, plus bar charts of trainable-parameter share and GPU memory.

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw the alternatives as identical copies of one stack and change only which modules are coloured trainable, so the difference is all the eye finds; then put cost bars beside the stacks with the same method names.
lessons.suits: Parameter-efficient or ablation-style comparisons where variants of one architecture differ in which parts are updated, with cost metrics to show the gain.

evidence: Trainable components are in blue, while frozen parameters are in gray.
Within the attention blocks, (a) only activates LayerNorm parameters.
Tuning LayerNorm achieves significant reductions in trainable parameters and GPU memory usages.

summary: The paper turns a text LLM into a multimodal LLM by finetuning only the LayerNorm weights inside each attention block, treating the change as domain adaptation. Figure 1 compares three tuning schemes on identical bottom-up stacks: ViT, V-L Connector, Word Emb., one attention block (LayerNorm, W_Q, W_K, W_V, Attention, MLP, residual sums) and LM Head. Blue boxes are trainable and grey ones frozen: (a) LayerNorm trains only the two LayerNorms, (b) QV Proj. / MLP trains W_Q, W_V and the MLP, (c) LoRA adds adapters marked by blue dots. At the right, two hatched horizontal bar charts give trainable parameters (%) and GPU memory (GB) for 7B and 13B models, where the LayerNorm bars are shorter than the LoRA bars.
summary_zh: 本文只微调注意力块中的 LayerNorm，把文本 LLM 变成多模态 LLM。左图用三个相同的堆叠结构对比 LayerNorm、QV 投影/MLP、LoRA，蓝色可训练、灰色冻结；右图条形图比较可训练参数占比与 GPU 显存。
notes: The index gives width 596.7 pt and aspect 3.39 for this figure; the printed figure is about 406 x 176 pt (aspect about 2.3), the index value is inflated by clipped off-canvas content. The blue dots in (c) are read as LoRA adapters on the enclosed weights from the figure and the caption's colour key; the paper text provided does not describe them. LayerNorm-simp. appears only as orange bars, there is no stack for it. The W boxes look white rather than grey in (a) and (c), grey only for W_K in (b). Bar values, tick labels and legend text are outlined paths, not in the text layer, so they were read from the preview.
